notes: Shared acceptance and rejection cases for the two-source edit recipe. Both languages must agree on `expect.ok` and, when accepted, on the exact reconstructed `output`. Rejection reasons are not standardized across languages. `input` is the base the applier holds under `input_revision` (default `input_revision_default`); `previous`, when present, is the retained applied output held under `previous.revision`. The recipe's own `base_revision` and `previous_output_revision` must match those held revisions. Canonical lengths are derived by each language from these values. Accepted cases also state `canonical_bytes`, the compact JSON length of the reconstructed array that both appliers must compute; fixture values contain only integers and strings, so the two languages' number formatting cannot diverge here.
